report:
Browser engine test > Screenshot delay setting > is not being saved

### 📑 I have found these related issues/pull requests

-

### 📝 Description

The setting "Screenshot Delay" of the Browser Engine test cannot be altered.

### 👟 Reproduction steps

1. Create a Browser Engine test. DO NOT add Screenshot delay. 
2. Save the test, make sure it runs succesfully
3. Modify test > add a Screenshot Delay.  
4. Save the test. Notice that the Screenshot Delay field is emptied and no setting is being saved.

I first noticed this on v2.2.3, but also v2.4.0 has this issue.

### 👀 Expected behavior

the setting is saved

### 😓 Actual Behavior

the setting is not saved

### 🐻 Uptime-Kuma Version

2.4.0

### 💻 Operating System and Arch

Docker

### 🌐 Browser

build in

### 🖥️ Deployment Environment

docker

evidence.quote: Thanks, which also means #6753 was never tested manually. (PR body: `screenshot_delay` was just never added to that list [editMonitor handler] when the feature was built. Resolves #7504)

notes: editMonitor socket handler and Monitor.toJSON() omitted screenshot_delay, so edits were dropped; fixed by 2-line PR.

reviews.decidable_why: Clear repro (edit-only loss); inspecting editMonitor field-by-field mapping in server.js shows screenshot_delay missing.
The repro (set the delay only on edit and it is lost) points straight to the editMonitor handler, and the missing field can be seen in server.js/monitor.js.
